analyzed: tasya bhakṣaḥ sarva gaṇasya te sarva gaṇa aśvibhyām pītasya tiroahniyasya somasya suṣutasya madhumataḥ upahūtasya upahūtaḥ bhakṣayāmi iti
hotṛ camasam eva ete trayaḥ samupahūya bhakṣayanti
yathācamasam camasān
hinva me iti ātmānam pratyabhimṛśante
na āpyāyayanti camasān
sarva bhakṣāḥ mārjayante

original: (17.10:291.13) atha saṃpraiṣam āha |< agnīd aupayajān aṅgārān āhara >|< upayaṣṭar upasīda >< brahman prasthāsyāmas >|< samidham ādhāyāgnīd agnīn sakṛtsakṛt saṃmṛḍḍhi >| iti |
analyzed: atha saṃpraiṣam āha agnīdh aupayajān aṅgārān āharaḥ upayaṣṭar upasīda brahman prasthāsyāmaḥ samidham ādhāya agnīdh agnīn sakṛt sakṛt saṃmṛḍḍhi iti
āharanti etān āgnīdhrāt aupayajān aṅgārān
tān agreṇa hotāram nivapati
upasīdati upayaṣṭā guda tṛtīyaiḥ
atra etāni guda tṛtīyāni ekādaśadhā kṛtvā upayaṣṭā upayajati
samānam atas ūrdhvam
saṃtiṣṭhate tirātraḥ

original: (17.11:292.1) ekādaśinīṃ kariṣyan yūpāhuti;m hutvātha tāṃ diśam eti yatra trayodaśa yupān vetsyan manyate
analyzed: ekādaśinīm kariṣyan yūpa āhutim hutvā atha tām diśam eti yatra trayodaśa yupān vetsyan manyate

original: (17.11:292.2) tān upaśayadvādaśān pātnīvatatrayodaśāñ chittvāvāhayaty ā vā hārayati |

original: (17.11:292.4) athāsyaiṣā pūrvedyur eva rathākṣeṇaikādaśadhā vedir vimitā bhavati
analyzed: atha asya eṣā pūrvedyus eva ratha akṣeṇa ekādaśadhā vediḥ vimitā bhavati

original: (17.11:292.5) sa yatrāgniṣṭhasya yūpāvaṭaṃ parilikhati tad eta;m rathākṣaṃ yācati
analyzed: sa yatra agniṣṭhasya yūpa avaṭam parilikhati tat etam ratha akṣam yācati

original: (17.11:292.6) tena dakṣiṇato mimīta uparasaṃmitaṃ yūpāvaṭaṃ parilikhati |
analyzed: tena dakṣiṇatas mimīte upara saṃmitam yūpa avaṭam parilikhati

original: (17.11:292.7) athodaṅ mimīta uparasaṃmitam eva yūpāvaṭaṃ parilikhati
analyzed: atha udak mimīte upara saṃmitam eva yūpa avaṭam parilikhati

original: (17.11:292.8) sa evam eva dakṣiṇam uttaram ity aṣṭau yūpāvaṭān parilikhati
analyzed: saḥ evam eva dakṣiṇam uttaram iti aṣṭau yūpa avaṭān parilikhati

original: (17.11:292.9) tad dhaitad eka upavasathīya evāhany etān yūpān ucchrayanti < yajamāno vā agniṣṭho 'ṅgānām itare rūpam > iti vadantaḥ
analyzed: tat ha etat eke upavasathīye eva ahani etān yūpān ucchrayanti yajamānaḥ vai agniṣṭhaḥ ṅgānām itare rūpam iti vadantaḥ

original: (17.11:292.10) sa yad enaṃ tatrānucchrayantaṃ brūyāt |< vyaṅgo nvā ayaṃ yajamāno bhaviṣyati >| iti tathā haiva syāt
analyzed: sa yat enam tatra an ucchrayantam brūyāt vyaṅgaḥ nvai ayam yajamānaḥ bhaviṣyati iti tathā ha eva syāt

original: (17.11:293.2) tad u vā āhus |< yad ime yūpā apaśavaḥ śūlībhūtās tiṣṭheyur yajñavāsturūpam iva syād yajñaveśasam iva >
analyzed: tat u vai āhuḥ yat ime yūpāḥ a paśavaḥ śūlībhūtāḥ tiṣṭheyuḥ yajña vāstu rūpam iva syāt yajñaveśasam iva

original: (17.11:293.3) < śvo bhūta evāhany etān yūpān ucchrayet >| iti
analyzed: śvas bhūte eva ahani etān yūpān ucchrayet iti
tān śvas bhūte eva ucchrayanti
agniṣṭhe ekādaśinīḥ aśanāḥ parivīya vāsayanti
samānam karma āśvināt grahāt

original: (17.12:293.6) āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvaikādaśa raśanā ādāya yūpam abhyaiti
analyzed: āśvinam graham gṛhītvā ekādaśa raśanāḥ ādāya yūpam abhyaiti

original: (17.12:293.7) tad ete yūpāḥ prakṣālitāḥ prapannāḥ saṃpannacaṣālāḥ prāgavaṭebhya upaśerate
analyzed: tat ete yūpāḥ prakṣālitāḥ prapannāḥ saṃpanna caṣālāḥ prāk avaṭebhyaḥ upaśerate

analyzed: svarvantam agniṣṭham utsṛjya tasmāt dakṣiṇam eva pūrvam upasthāvānam ucchrayati atha uttaram

original: (17.12:293.9) sa evam eva dakṣiṇam uttaram ity aṣṭau yūpān ucchrayati |
analyzed: saḥ evam eva dakṣiṇam uttaram iti aṣṭau yūpān ucchrayati
atha vai bhavati

original: (17.12:293.10) < uparasaṃmitāṃ minuyāt pitṛlokakāmasya >| iti samā upareṣu bhavanti
analyzed: upara saṃmitām minuyāt pitṛ loka kāmasya iti samāḥ upareṣu bhavanti

original: (17.12:293.11) < raśanasaṃmitāṃ manuṣyalokakāmasya >| iti samā raśanāsu bhavanti
analyzed: raśana saṃmitām manuṣya loka kāmasya iti samāḥ raśanāsu bhavanti

original: (17.12:293.12) < caṣālasaṃmitām indriyakāmasya >| iti samāś caṣāleṣu bhavanti
analyzed: caṣāla saṃmitām indriya kāmasya iti samāḥ caṣāleṣu bhavanti

original: (17.12:293.13) < sarvān samān pratiṣṭhākāmasya >| iti sarvān samān pratiṣṭhākāmasya karoti
analyzed: sarvān samān pratiṣṭhā kāmasya iti sarvān samān pratiṣṭhā kāmasya karoti

original: (17.12:293.14) < ye trayo madhyamās tān samān paśukāmasya >| iti tān samān paśukāmasya karoti

original: (17.12:294.1) sa evam eva dakṣiṇam uttaram ity aṣṭau yūpān vyatiṣajati //
analyzed: saḥ evam eva dakṣiṇam uttaram iti aṣṭau yūpān vyatiṣajati

original: (17.13:294.3) < yaṃ kāmayeta pramāyukaḥ syād iti gartamitaṃ tasya minuyād uttarārdhyaṃ varṣiṣṭham atha hrasīyā;msam > iti |
analyzed: yam kāmayeta pramāyukaḥ syāt iti garta mitam tasya minuyāt uttarārdhyam varṣiṣṭham atha hrasīyāmsam iti

original: (17.13:294.4) uttarārdhyam atra varṣiṣṭhaṃ minoti dakṣiṇārdhya;m hrasīyā;msam
analyzed: uttarārdhyam atra varṣiṣṭham minoti dakṣiṇārdhyam hrasīyāmsam

original: (17.13:294.5) < eṣā vai gartamid yasyaivaṃ minoti tājak pramīyate >| iti brāhmaṇam |
analyzed: eṣā vai gartamit yasya evam minoti tājak pramīyate iti brāhmaṇam

analyzed: dakṣiṇārdhyam varṣiṣṭham minuyāt suvarga kāmasya atha hrasīyāmsam iti

original: (17.13:294.7) dakṣiṇārdhyam atra varṣiṣṭhaṃ minoty uttarārdhya;m hrasīyā;msam
analyzed: dakṣiṇārdhyam atra varṣiṣṭham minoti uttarārdhyam hrasīyāmsam

original: (17.13:294.8) < ākramaṇam eva tat setuṃ yajamānaḥ kurute suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai >| iti brāhmaṇam
analyzed: ākramaṇam eva tat setum yajamānaḥ kurute suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai iti brāhmaṇam

analyzed: yat ekasmin yūpe dve raśane parivyayati tasmāt ekaḥ dve jāye vindate

original: (17.13:294.11) < yan naikā;m raśanāṃ dvayor yūpayoḥ parivyayati tasmān naikā dvau patī vindate >| iti brāhmaṇam
analyzed: yat na ekām raśanām dvayoḥ yūpayoḥ parivyayati tasmāt na ekā dvau patī vindate iti brāhmaṇam

original: (17.14:295.2) < ya evāvagataḥ so 'parudhyate yo 'paruddhaḥ so 'vagacchati >| iti brāhmaṇam
analyzed: yaḥ eva avagataḥ saḥ parudhyate yaḥ paruddhaḥ saḥ vagacchati iti brāhmaṇam

analyzed: yat pām vāruṇam ālabheta prajāḥ varuṇaḥ gṛhṇīyāt

analyzed: teṣām prasiddham vapābhiḥ caritvā prasarpanti prātaḥsavanāya
tat ṛjudhā saṃtiṣṭhate

analyzed: iṣṭam vapayā bhavati an iṣṭam vaśayā atha pātnīvatena pracarati iti

original: (17.15:295.18) sa yatraikādaśinyā anubandhyasyeṣṭaṃ vapayā bhavaty aniṣṭaṃ vaśayā tajjaghanena gārhapatyam aupasadāyāṃ vedyā;m stambayajur harati |

idam eva prasiddham pauroḍāśikam

pūrvam parigrāham parigṛhṇāti
karaṇam japati
uddhanti
uddhatāt āgnīdhraḥ tris harati

analyzed: yat āgnīdhraḥ tris harati atha agreṇa gārhapatyam pātnīvatasya yūpa avaṭam parilikhati

original: (17.15:296.5) sādayitvā sruco 'greṇa gārhapatyaṃ pātnīvatam ucchritya tasmi;ms tvāṣṭra;m sāṇḍam ajaṃ paśum upākaroti

original: (17.15:296.8) atyākramyāśrāvyāha < tvaṣṭāram > ity upā;mśu < yaja >| ity uccais |
analyzed: atyākramya āśrāvya āha tvaṣṭāram iti upa amśu yaje iti uccais

iti nu vapāyāḥ praticarati

original: (17.15:296.9) catura evājyasya gṛhṇāna āha < tvaṣṭre >| ity upā;mśu |< anubrūhi >| ity uccaiḥ //
analyzed: caturaḥ eva ājyasya gṛhṇānaḥ āha tvaṣṭre iti upa amśu anubrūhi iti uccais

original: (17.16:296.11) atyākramyāśrāvyāha < tvaṣṭāram > ity upā;mśu < yaja >| ity uccais |
analyzed: atyākramya āśrāvya āha tvaṣṭāram iti upa amśu yaje iti uccais
vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti
iti nu paśupuroḍāśasya praticarati

original: (17.16:296.12) catura evājyasya gṛhṇāna āha |< agnaye >| ity upā;mśu |< anubrūhi >| ity uccais |
analyzed: caturaḥ eva ājyasya gṛhṇānaḥ āha agnaye iti upa amśu anubrūhi iti uccais

analyzed: caturaḥ eva ājyasya gṛhṇānaḥ āha tvaṣṭre iti upa amśu anubrūhi iti uccais

original: (17.16:296.17) atyākramyāśrāvyāha < tvaṣṭāram > ity upā;mśu < yaja >| ity uccais |
analyzed: atyākramya āśrāvya āha tvaṣṭāram iti upa amśu yaje iti uccais

original: (17.17:297.3) < yo 'gnyādheyena nardhnoti sa punarādheyam ādhatte yo 'gniṃ citvā nardhnoti sa punaścitiṃ cinute >| iti |
analyzed: yaḥ gnyādheyena na ṛdhnoti sa punarādheyam ādhatte yaḥ gnim citvā na ṛdhnoti sa punaścitim cinute iti

original: (17.17:297.4) agniṃ citvā jyānāno dvādaśeṣṭakā upakalpayate 'ṣṭau yājuṣīś catasro lokaṃpṛṇāḥ
analyzed: agnim citvā jyānānaḥ dvādaśa iṣṭakāḥ upakalpayate ṣṭau yājuṣīḥ catasraḥ lokaṃpṛṇāḥ

original: (17.17:297.6) sa yatra hottaravedir vyāghāritopanyuptasaṃbhārā bhavati tad dvābhyām ātmany agniṃ gṛhṇīte < mayi gṛhṇāmy agre agnim >|< yo no agnis >| iti
analyzed: sa yatra ha uttaravediḥ vyāghārita upanyupta saṃbhārā bhavati tat dvābhyām ātmani agnim gṛhṇīte mayi gṛhṇāmi agre agnim yaḥ naḥ agniḥ iti

original: (17.17:297.8) svayaṃcitiṃ japati < yās te agne samidho yāni dhāma >| iti
analyzed: svayaṃcitim japati yāḥ te agne samidhaḥ yāni dhāma iti

original: (17.17:297.9) śvetam aśvam abhimṛśyāṣṭau yājuṣīr upadadhāti < yenarṣayas tapasā sattram āsata >| iti
analyzed: śvetam aśvam abhimṛśya aṣṭau yājuṣīḥ upadadhāti yena ṛṣayaḥ tapasā sattram āsate iti

original: (17.17:297.10) catasro lokaṃpṛṇās |< lokaṃ pṛṇa chidraṃ pṛṇa >| iti |
analyzed: catasraḥ lokaṃpṛṇāḥ lokam pṛṇa chidram pṛṇa iti

original: (30.2:392.3) caturaśraṃ praugaṃ cikīrṣan yāvac cikīrṣed dvis tāvatīṃ bhūmi;m samacaturaśrāṃ kṛtvā pūrvasyāḥ karaṇyā madhye śaṅkuṃ nihanyāt
